prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1206; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center with the left taillight assembly broken and the trunk lid edge scuffed, which lines up well with the low-speed impact described in the loss report. The lower quarter panel shows matching paint transfer and a shallow dent consistent with the same contact point. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and the repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the trunk lid, and straightening the quarter panel. The labor hours requested fit the scope of these repairs, and the supplied invoices show each charge appearing once with no repeated line items.
